g:HTMLPanel.p: Collapsible panels: an Accordion of AccordionItems, each with a header and a body.

d:Example.heading: Basic
d:Example.description: By default one item is open at a time. `open` sets the item that starts open; the header and body are linked for you.

d:Example.heading: Flush and always open
d:Example.description: `flush` removes the borders so the accordion sits edge to edge in its parent; `alwaysOpen` lets several items stay open.

d:Example.heading: From Java
d:Example.description: `setOpen` opens or closes an item, with the animation once it is on the page.
